name: saica-supervise
description: One skill file built from the SAICA catalog: for each of the 11 failure modes of AI coding agents, what to watch for and which catalog tools are tagged for it, plus three tool stacks built from those tags. A tag is what a tool says it addresses, not a measurement. Markdown only, no runtime dependencies. The MCP server (saica_lookup, saica_recommend) lives in the repository and needs Python.
